open: Send the analysis just done to a skill_hub draft
title: Analysis for a skill_hub draft
description: Download the request, final answer and selected files as material for a skill or Workflow draft in skill_hub.
rawData: Raw data under user_data/ is included only when you select it. Content written in the request and answer is included, so review it before downloading.
loading: Reading the analysis and file list.
truncated: Long text or per-file step lists were truncated. The bundle records the same limits.
emptyFiles: No files are available to send. You can download the request and answer alone.
excluded: Excluded {count} files from the list due to path or size limits, deletion or read failures.
sizeHelp: Up to 200 files, 5 MiB per file and 20 MiB for the whole bundle. Files are read again at download time to include their current contents.
note: Note for skill_hub (optional, up to 4,000 characters)
noSite: No skill_hub site is configured. You can still download the bundle.
attach: Open a draft in skill_hub and attach the downloaded analysis bundle. GAID does not upload the files.
sendDirect: Send a draft to local skill_hub
directHelp: You can also send the selected bundle directly to the configured local skill_hub. If direct delivery cannot be confirmed, the bundle is downloaded.

path.direct: Sent directly to local skill_hub. If a new tab did not open, use the draft link.
path.download-fallback: Direct delivery could not be confirmed, so the download path was used. Check whether skill_hub already created a draft before attaching the bundle.

errors.input: Check the file selection and note, then download again.
errors.session: The chat record was not found. Reopen the chat and try again.
errors.file: A selected file cannot be sent. Reopen the dialog to check the file list.
errors.size: A file or bundle exceeds the size limit. Select fewer files. If the chat record is too large, choose another chat.
errors.request: The analysis handoff request failed. Check the server connection and try again.
